content.text:
**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position met).**

- No minimum purchase, volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic exists anywhere in the Agreement; targeted searches for "minimum", commitment, volume, shortfall and take-or-pay returned no hits, and the only fee sections (§ 1, § 3) contain none.
- Engagement is "on a task by task basis" under Statements of Work (§ 1(a)), and compensation is time-and-materials as set forth in each SOW plus actual out-of-pocket expenses (§ 3(a)) — i.e., we pay only for services we order.
- § 6(b) confirms that on termination Contractor is paid only fees and expenses "incurred or earned" through the effective date, so no committed residual spend survives an exit.
- No redline proposed. The only adjacent point (Contractor's right to change rates on 30 days' notice, § 3(b)) is a pricing/uplift issue, not a volume commitment, and is left to the relevant pricing rule.
